name: CreateHub
title: Blocks/Create/CreateHub
summary: The Creation Center, where a project starts: the creation header with a single current crumb and a back control to Home, a large page heading whose lead offers to upload a file or a folder through the system picker, then two columns side by side from the large breakpoint. On the left, Import from GitHub: a bordered EmptyState with Continue with GitHub until an account is connected (a danger Alert under the button when the connection fails), then an account Select with an Add GitHub account option, a search that also takes a repository URL, and a flush list of the ten most recently pushed repositories with a named Import button each and Load more for the rest; skeleton rows with a status line while a scope loads, a danger Alert with Retry when the list fails to load, and a small EmptyState with Clear search when nothing matches. On the right, Start from template: a template search over a faded ScrollArea holding Recommended framework cards in three columns, then the starter templates, one per kind of resource, and every other framework as two-column integration Cards with the vendor beside the title; each tile links to its deploy page, and a search with no match shows an EmptyState with Clear search. Each Recommended card turns its mark from grey to colour and lights a glow drawn from its mark on hover and focus. Built from `PageHeader`, `AppHeader`, `Breadcrumb`, `EmptyState`, `Alert`, `Link`, `Select`, `Input`, `Card`, `Item`, `Skeleton`, `ScrollArea` and `Button`.

variants.name: Connected
variants.summary: GitHub connected: jane-doe is the selected scope and its ten most recently pushed repositories are listed, with Load more for the other two.

variants.name: RepositoriesLoading
variants.summary: A scope just picked: six skeleton rows, hidden from assistive technology, stand in for the repositories while one status line says they are loading.

variants.name: ConnectError
variants.summary: The GitHub connection failed: the connect EmptyState stays, with a danger Alert under Continue with GitHub saying the authorization did not finish; pressing the button again retries.

variants.name: LoadError
variants.summary: The repositories of the jane-doe scope failed to load: a danger Alert with Retry takes the place of the list, while the scope Select and the search stay usable.
